name: War-Awoken Sketch Mimicry Dragonking (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒ものまね絵画・竜王
effects:
Single-target Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if there are 0-1/2+ members with Attach Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth allies
WS Blue: Dualcast Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth 3, Instant Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, chases ally's Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth ability with Mimic 2 to user (max 4 chases)
